description: Given what a truck does (hard start, power loss, white smoke, coolant loss, noise, DEF warnings ...), list the documented failure modes that show that sign, per engine. Lists documented causes; it does not diagnose a truck.

platform.description: Optional platform id to narrow to one engine

symptom.description: A symptom such as hard-start, power-loss, coolant-loss, noise, emissions-warnings

name: get_symptoms
title: Match a symptom to documented causes
